**`homeassistant/components/roborock/vacuum.py`**
- Added imports: `asyncio`, `Segment`, `ServiceValidationError`, and `MAP_SLEEP`.

- Implemented `async_get_segments()` — iterates every loaded floor map in `home_trait.home_map_info` and returns a `Segment` per room with `id` = `"{map_flag}:{segment_id}"`, `name` = room name, `group` = map/floor name. Returns `[]` when no map data is loaded.

  - If segments span more than one map, raises `ServiceValidationError` (`multiple_maps_in_clean`) with the offending map flags.
